collaborators.name: Adam Fry
collaborators.bio: Fry has spent 18+ years building networks in the field, from carrier fiber to data-center-grade IDF/MDF rooms. He deploys network infrastructure at 75-150 high-security sites a year and designed Hacker Dojo's Wi-Fi 7 network. At Zero State he brings hands-on infrastructure, clean cutovers and a habit of testing everything.

collaborators.name: Badri Rajendran
collaborators.role: Collaborator, BlackDog - full-stack and GenAI engineer
collaborators.bio: Badri is a full-stack software engineer in the San Francisco Bay Area who builds production GenAI systems: LLM agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evals. He works with Zero State on BlackDog.
